name: cn.dianyinhuoban.hm.mvp.home.view.ShareQRActivity
description: The Dianyin Guanjia Hongmeng Edition (电银管家泓盟版) SDK from holderman has a screen that creates a shareable referral card with the user’s name and referral code, which can be saved or shared from the home screen.
disableEffect: Users will lose the referral QR card and its save and share actions.
